failureReasons.ACTION_NOT_PERFORMED: The agent finished without doing what it was built to do. Open the run to see which step it skipped.
failureReasons.NO_EXECUTOR: This agent asks for something the CRM cannot do yet. It needs rebuilding.
failureReasons.DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE: A connection this agent needs is missing. Reconnect it, then run again.
failureReasons.NOT_AUTHORISED: The connection refused this. Its access may have been revoked or narrowed.
failureReasons.PROVIDER_ERROR: The outside service rejected this. It is usually worth trying again.
failureReasons.NEVER_SETTLED: The agent stopped without reporting a result. Nothing was left half-done.
failureReasons.TURN_FAILED: The model failed part-way through this run.
failureReasons.DELIVERY_FAILED: The run never reached the agent.
failureReasons.DELIVERY_EXHAUSTED: This never reached the agent after three attempts. Nothing ran.
failureReasons.ACTION_REJECTED: The agent tried the action and the CRM refused it. Nothing was written.
failureReasons.AGENT_UNAVAILABLE: The agent was paused or archived when this run started.
failureReasons.AGENT_DELETED: The agent was deleted before this run finished.
failureReasons.RUN_TIMED_OUT: This run took too long and was stopped so later runs could start.

agentHistory.failureReasonUnknown: This run failed without saying why.
